story.title: Premji Invest in Talks to Join Emergent's $250M Fundraise at $1.5 Billion Valuation
story.summary: Premji Invest is reportedly in advanced discussions to participate in AI coding platform Emergent's $250 million funding round, which would value the company at $1.5 billion. This follows Emergent's $70 million raise just three months earlier, signalling rapid investor confidence in AI-native software development tools. The potential backing from one of India's most respected institutional investors would further validate Emergent's position in the fast-growing agentic coding space.
